I’ll assume you are referring to the “cowboy chord” starting from the 5th string. Start with one finger at a time. Place your index finger across strings 1-5 (skinny to 2nd biggest) at the 2nd fret. X is the low E string and will not be played for your purposes. Left to right is each string from low to high:

X-2-2-2-2-2. Play each note separately. Pick each note cleanly. Next add the V of the chord with your ring finger; X-2-4-2-2-2, next add the 8ve with your pinky; X-2-4-4-2-2, and finally add the iii with your middle finger; X-2-4-4-3-2. If you want to further the practice, you can “add the V in the bass” 2-2-4-4-3-2 which is an inversion and adds depth to the chord, once your hand is strong enough to play it.
